describe:
Qurbani, in the pink colours.
Works out:
- seats is 1 when animal is Goat, otherwise 7.
- animals is people divided by seats rounded down plus 1 when people divided by seats is more than people divided by seats rounded down, otherwise 0.
- each cost is price divided by seats.
Remembers while you use it: animal, starting at Cow; price, starting at 280000; people, starting at 5.
Shows:
- a card titled "Choose" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number animals, labelled "animal to buy" ifanimals = 1, "", "each at the price above", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: each cost rounded, labelled "each share".
- a big number: animals times price rounded, labelled "total if you buy whole animals".
- if animal is not Goat and people leaves over when divided by 7 is not 0:
  - text: "A cow or camel has 7 shares. Share the last animal with others or add", 7 minus people leaves over when divided by 7, "more people.".
needs: animal choice goat, cow or camel

- a big number: det, labelled "detractors".

- a button "Remove last answer"; a tap removes the latest answer entries, with undo.

Shows:
- a card titled "Your run" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- if total is more than 0 hours:
  - text: pace.
  - text: "per km".
  - text: "Speed", the fixed of kmh, "km/h".
  - a card titled "Predicted finish times" with "Riegel formula" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Enter a distance and a time to see your pace.".
